description: Improves BB's Diff tab with a folder tree beside the file list: file counts and +/- per folder, sticky folders, Tree or Flat view, compact folders, a view synced with the list, and your recent commits in the scope picker. It works through the tab's own filter, so BB's search, Viewed marks, split view and Add to chat work as before. Requires BB 0.48 or later; it finds the Diff tab by its page structure, so a BB update may need a plugin update.
